runner: Gemini 3.8 Flash High via Antigravity IDE
notes: Single-shot run in Antigravity IDE. Full 3D cinematic scene built in Three.js featuring 4 articulated custom-modeled characters (Michael Jackson in iconic red/black Thriller jacket with single silver sequin glove & black penny loafers; Pepe the Frog in classic blue polo; Donald Trump in navy suit with long signature red silk tie & swooped pompadour hair; Elon Musk in dark SpaceX cyber jacket). Implements a hierarchical bone/joint animation system executing the complete 16-beat Thriller choreography (zombie head snaps, hunched lurches, rhythmic double claw swipes left/right, shoulder pops, hip rolls, and climactic zombie roar poses). Environment features a moonlit gothic cemetery (weathered tombstones, twisted barren trees, flickering glowing jack-o'-lanterns, volumetric full moon with glow corona, undulating terrain with PCF soft shadows, and drifting ground fog particles). Includes multi-angle director camera modes (Cinematic Crane Sweep, Low Hero, Free OrbitControls) and a Web Audio API 80s Thriller bassline & drum machine synthesizer.
